newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News Corp slip after poor first half.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News Corp slip after poor first half.

text.p: The shares of News Corp Ltd were weaker in early trade on Thursday after the company reported half year earnings at the lower end of expectations.
At 10.15 a.m. (2315 GMT), News Corp shares were nine cents weaker at A$6.77.

The company earlier posted second quarter net earnings of A$407 million, bringing its net profit for the six months to December 31 to A$690 million compared to A$702 million in the previous corresponding half. News Corp's pre-abnormal net profit of A$731 million were just below the bottom end of Australian analysts' forecasts of between A$735 million to A$775 million.

"The way News Corp's shares have been rising in the last week, I think investors were expecting the company to report at the higher end of analsyts' expectations. It (the price) has been talked up and now it's looking a bit overdone," said Jamie Spiteri, a dealer at Sydney firm, Shaw Stockbroking.
